comments.text:
"𝑨𝒏𝒅, 𝒃𝒆𝒉𝒐𝒍𝒅, 𝑰 𝒄𝒐𝒎𝒆 𝒒𝒖𝒊𝒄𝒌𝒍𝒚; 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒎𝒚 𝒓𝒆𝒘𝒂𝒓𝒅 𝒊𝒔 𝒘𝒊𝒕𝒉 𝒎𝒆, 𝒕𝒐 𝒈𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒆𝒗𝒆𝒓𝒚 𝒎𝒂𝒏 𝒂𝒄𝒄𝒐𝒓𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝒂𝒔 𝒉𝒊𝒔 𝒘𝒐𝒓𝒌 𝒔𝒉𝒂𝒍𝒍 𝒃𝒆." Revelation 22:12
Good people, Lord Jesus is coming soon so I took the time and space to warn you to open your bibles to know Him, repent, let yourselves be guided by the Holy Spirit and follow the Lord while there is still time! Now is the time to pull away of all the distractions and go to Him and "𝒕𝒂𝒔𝒕𝒆 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒔𝒆𝒆 𝒕𝒉𝒂𝒕 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝑳𝒐𝒓𝒅 𝒊𝒔 𝒈𝒐𝒐𝒅" - Psalm 34:8. May God fill us with light, wisdom and fire for Him! Amen 🙏❤
